narrative: Each row is one state-type partnership pattern your deal team may encounter. Read across the columns left to right: sanctions exposure tells you which regulatory reach can reprice your arrangement without touching your contracts directly; lock-in depth counts the compounding obligation layers between entry and a clean exit; reversal constraint names the type of obstacle — political, financial, institutional, or industrial — that stands between you and the door. The case evidence column anchors every score in documented fact, not inference. The go/no-go badge is the bottom line: apply the five quarterly criteria before heads of agreement are signed, and decline or renegotiate any deal that fails two or more.
why_this_perspective: Executives need a single pre-signature decision tool that converts dense analytical findings into scored rows with verdicts; the register format delivers that without requiring the reader to parse theory.
